response.sql: WITH operator_rates AS (SELECT crewref, COUNT(*) AS scan_count, AVG(gbsize / NULLIF(spanmin, 0)) AS avg_gb_per_minute FROM scans WHERE gbsize IS NOT NULL AND spanmin IS NOT NULL AND spanmin <> 0 GROUP BY crewref), all_operator_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_gb_per_minute) AS rate FROM operator_rates) SELECT AVG(scan_count) AS avg_scan_count, AVG(avg_gb_per_minute) AS avg_gb_per_minute, AVG(avg_gb_per_minute - all_operator_avg.rate) AS avg_margin_above_all_operator_avg FROM operator_rates CROSS JOIN all_operator_avg WHERE avg_gb_per_minute > all_operator_avg.rate;
